patch_description: This design replaces the large screened batches and archive-guided relinking with several parallel simulated-annealing walks. Each walk has a different acceptance temperature, so some exploit improving local moves while others can cross score barriers; occasional state exchanges let good discoveries spread between walks. LP calls are spent one at a time on valid, previously unscored proposals. Bottleneck links guide switch proposals, while random switches and three-link rotations preserve exploration when the LP dual information is incomplete. Repaired QAOA samples still provide diverse, energy-ranked starting points, but the search thereafter is driven by exact LP scores rather than surrogate ranking alone.
